title: Project Context Matrix — in-repo, machine-readable, kept alive by every change
context: As the project grows, LLM chats waste tokens re-reading the codebase from scratch to reason about it. Human docs drift. The Claude conversation history is not reachable from fresh sessions.
decision: Introduce `.context/` at the repo root: a set of JSON files that a new chat reads INSTEAD of the source. MANIFEST.json is the entry point. Files split by concern: project, architecture, data-model, api, frontend, backend, ai, conventions. Decisions live under `decisions/`. A `changes/` folder holds a daily append-only journal.
principles: Not documentation — machine-readable JSON, not prose for humans.
Not the codebase — the whole point is to stop re-reading source.
Alive — updated on every meaningful change.
Structured — YAML-like keys and short strings; scannable in a few hundred tokens.
In repo — versioned in git alongside the code.
consequences: .context/update.py regenerates the auto files and bumps MANIFEST.json
Every code change either the assistant or the human updates the affected .context/*.json alongside
Drift-detection is future work: compare committed api.json to current OpenAPI on CI
